description: This file implements the JSON Web Token (JWT) handling, including encoding, decoding, signature validation, and related data structures within the WPEFramework Web namespace.

classes.name: JSONWebData
classes.description: A JSON container class representing the JWT header with fields for type and algorithm.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::JSONWebToken
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JWT with a specified mode, key length, and key data, setting up the header.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a payload into a JWT token string, including header, payload, and signature if SHA256 mode is used.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a JWT token string into payload data, verifying the signature and extracting the payload.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::ValidSignature
methods.description: Validates the signature of a JWT token based on the specified mode.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::PayloadLength
methods.description: Calculates the payload length from a JWT token string.
